title: RustScreen — Architecture & Implementation Roadmap
summary: Combined architecture and phased (P0-P8) implementation roadmap for turning a Pixel 6a into a wired Rust-based secondary monitor for an M1 MacBook over USB-C.
scope: Cargo workspace (protocol, macos-host, cg-virtual-display, android-client crates)
notes: Ambiguous between DOC, SPEC, and ADR. Classified DOC because the document is primarily a planning/roadmap (8 phases with tasks, acceptance criteria, checkbox tracking, risk register, definition of done) rather than a single implementation contract or single locked decision. NOTE: it embeds a locked decisions table D0-D7 (D0-D3 marked '✅ locked from review') with ADR-like force, plus SPEC-like content (protocol wire format 'u8 tag · u32 len · payload', workspace/file structure, target architecture diagram, latency budget). The synthesizer may wish to extract D0-D3 as locked decisions and the protocol/architecture sections as technical constraints despite the overall DOC classification.
